reason: Close the production gap where PentaPM worker assignment terminated at GitHub labels/comments without creating an executable task, durable queue message, worker lease, branch evidence writeback, or verified handoff to PentaPR terminal authority.

changes.reason: Add the trusted repository-dispatch and five-minute bounded sweep that consumes Penta remediation assignments through PentaBuild/PentaCertify, ThriveBase service-role RPCs, exact-head checks, evidence writeback, and verified-only hold release.
Extend the remediation contract gate to compile and test the assignment-to-execution worker, workflow, and canonical migration while preserving read-only PR candidate execution.

evidence.root_cause: PentaPM assignment labels were metadata-only; no Penta execution queue consumer was bound to assigned remediation PRs.

exclusions: No D3 authority is granted or expanded; D3 execution remains held.
No provider, money-movement, deploy, publish, or rights authority is inherited by worker assignment.
No penta:hold is removed until the execution ledger reports verified provider-side evidence.
No external-fork remediation branch receives trusted credentials or mutation authority.
The receipt does not substitute for exact-head GitHub checks, Governed Merge Gate, PentaSELF verification, or PentaCertify evidence.
